scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: San Diego State University Common Data Set 2025-26 (PDF, updated 7/28)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 first-year class, C1): 95,444 applied, 35,709 admitted (37.4%), 6,911 enrolled; the gender rows and the residency rows (in-state, out-of-state, international) both add up to the totals. International first-years: 1,596 applied, 942 admitted, 143 enrolled. No early decision or early action. Waiting list: 11,627 qualified applicants were offered a place, 6,016 accepted it and 962 were admitted. SDSU is an impacted campus (every major has more applicants than places). SAT/ACT are not used in admission (test-blind): the Common Data Set gives no test-score percentiles or submission rates and IPEDS (fall 2024) lists no SAT/ACT ranges, so none are shown. The GPA breakdown is the all-enrolled column (whole percentages). Undergraduate enrollment (36,196) is the 'Total undergraduates' figure and the nonresident count (842) is the B2 nonresident row for the same group.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set C8A: SAT/ACT are not used in admission decisions ('not considered, even if submitted'); C8F: SDSU 'no longers uses ACT or SAT examinations in determining admission eligibility'; scores can be used for math and English placement.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 for 2026-27: tuition $6,838 (in-state) and $20,968 (nonresident), required fees $2,824, an 'Out of State and International Student Fee' of $3,112, and on-campus food and housing $24,749. Estimated expenses for residents: books $1,014, transportation $1,216, other $2,566 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Common Data Set H6: SDSU's own need-based and non-need-based aid is available to degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates; 73 received it (average $29,537, total $2,156,216). SDSU's own scholarship FAQ says F-1 students cannot file the FAFSA or CA Dream Act application, so need-based awards that require them are out of reach
